## **Devora**

This abomination is too busy consuming to form a cohesive thought. 

---

We do not know the origins of Devora or what has led it down on this path. All we know is that it wreaks destruction in its wake. It has an insatiable gluttony for devouring anything and everything. Every moment of its existence is dedicated to destruction and consumption. 

Devora is… a freak of nature even by our standards. We don't know what compels it to continue feeding on stars so relentlessly but it is something that cannot be left unchecked. Do not approach carelessly. 

---

#### **Nature** 

Dormant, Isolated, Greedy, Lustful, Wrathful, Gluttonous, Apathetic, Abomination 

#### **Ideals** 

*All Consuming Greed.* Everything is mine and mine alone to covet and devour.
